GitHub Agentic Workflows is now generally available, bringing coding agents into GitHub Actions with read-only-by-default permissions and separately scoped write jobs.

However, these safeguards don't automatically cover direct write permissions or custom jobs. Security still depends on how each workflow is configured.

🔗 Read more: https://www.infoq.com/news/2026/11/github-agentic-workflows-ga/
